answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 10358 Country: Bangladesh Title: Is there any hadith available translation of which is given below? ?There is nothing better for two who love each other than marriage.? I have found some sources 1. Sahih Al-Jami`, 5200 2. recorded by Ibn-Majah is the translation is right? Question: Is there any hadith available translation of which is given below? ?There is nothing better for two who love each other than marriage.? I have found some sources 1. Sahih Al-Jami`, 5200 2. recorded by Ibn-Majah is the translation is right? Answer ID: 10358 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 137/137=M/1429) The Hadith is mentioned in Ibn Majah with the words: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: لم یر للمتحابین مثل النکاح ( ابن ماجہ: 133 ) The Messenger of Allah said: Lovers like that of Nikah are not seen i.e. the love gained out of Nikah is matchless. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
